subject.facility_name: WHISPERING PINES REHABILITATION AND NURSING CENTER

executive_summary.text: Current ownership interests reported to CMS: LOUIS A VITERITTI (5% Or Greater Direct Ownership Interest); MICHAEL BARTOLOTTA (5% Or Greater Direct Ownership Interest).
Cost year 2024: related party disclosed as "WP Realty LLC" for rental of real estate, cost reported $721,620 (p 22 LINE 9).
Cost year 2024: related party disclosed as "WP Management LLC" for management services, cost reported $555,101 (p 16 M 12).
Cost year 2024: the home reported $555,101 in management fees (cost report line m12), $18.62 per resident day (Connecticut median $10.84 among homes reporting a fee).
Cost year 2024: total nursing pool (agency) fees on the report were $182,173, of which $94,470 is counted in direct care.

Cost year 2024: DSS's review changed 27 line(s) of the report, a net reduction of $1,051,263 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Administrative Management Services (page 16 line m12), removed $354,700; Other Resident Care Supplies (page 20 line 5m), removed $193,011; Medical And Therapeutic Supplies (page 20 line 5c), added $191,880. Separately, the home itself removed $94,186 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.
Missing data: cost years 2020, 2021 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
